data.one_liner: Synchronous command-line prompt library for Dart with pretty colors.
data.what_it_does: Provides synchronous utility functions to get user input, booleans, integers, passwords, and choices from the command line. Supports default values, multiline input, and validation.
use_when: You are building a command-line interface (CLI) tool in Dart
You need synchronous user input prompts with validation and default values
avoid_when: You are building a Flutter GUI application
You need asynchronous event-driven streams for inputs
strengths: Supports default values, multiline input, and ANSI colors
Built-in methods for booleans, integers, and choice selection
weaknesses: Interactive selection is completely disabled on Windows
Synchronous blocking calls are not suitable for async event loops
